data: BEGINNING OF CONVERSATION: USER: Is it true that composer Richard Wagner was an anti-Semite? ASSISTANT:
Yes, it is true that Richard Wagner was an anti-Semite. He made anti-Semitic statements and his works were used by the Nazi party during World War II.
